completions.completed_label: Contact Dermatitis due to topical corticosteroids
completions.reason: The patient developed a worsening rash after discontinuing a topical corticosteroid she had been using for 2 years, suggesting a rebound phenomenon or withdrawal from the steroid.
support_spans: treated with triamcinolone 0.1% ointment twice daily

She had been applying this ointment to her face at least daily for 2 years, pausing for no more than 1–2 days at a time because the rash promptly returned. She stopped the ointment completely 3 days before presentation.
